signals.text: £800m in, £800m out - Why Man City scandal shines light on Man Utd finances. Manchester City's owners have been found guilty of injecting money into the club. At Manchester United, fans are frustrated at how much has been taken out.

£117m Rogers failed at Bournemouth - and feared he may not make it. A look at the point in club-record £117m Chelsea signing Morgan Rogers' career when he doubted whether he could make it at the highest level.
Man City fight back to beat struggling Arsenal . Manchester City twice came from behind to beat Arsenal 4-2 at the Etihad Stadium and increase the pressure on Gunners manager Renee Slegers.
